title: Active Surface-Potential Measurement Design for Physics-Informed Reconstruction of Buried Grounding Electrodes: Reproducibility Package
description: Version 1.2.1 completes the v1.2.0 reproducibility package by adding the full post-hoc benchmark archive, including the complete 200-layout Random casewise results and the D-optimal and numerical full-grid casewise results. No scientific results, methods, or manuscript conclusions were changed. The additional benchmark analyses reuse the already-consumed 84-case FEM population and are reported as post-hoc comparative benchmarks rather than as a new independent validation set.
